web.ffmpeg: libx264 preset medium crf 21 g8 keyint_min8 sc_threshold0 bf0 movflags+faststart -an

treatment: No new encode, generated frames, recolouring, cuts or face edits. The existing H.264 encode is lossy. One source-aspect video stays centered horizontally and vertically while uniformly zooming into a strictly clipped 100vh window. The heading and paragraph occupy opposite corners, with measured clearance. The rounded diagonal background uses symmetric insets, Deep Teal and approved #E6ECEC. Source chronology and proportions are preserved.
